description: This file defines the FileStream class, an interface for synchronous and asynchronous file I/O operations, including open, close, read, write, seek, get file info, and flush functionalities.

classes.name: net::FileStream
classes.description: A class providing an interface for asynchronous and synchronous file stream operations, including open, close, read, write, seek, get file info, and flush.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a file asynchronously with specified flags, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the file asynchronously, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the file stream is currently open.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Adjusts the read/write position in the file asynchronously.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data asynchronously from the current position into a buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data asynchronously from a buffer to the current position.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Forces a filesystem sync on the file asynchronously.
